f6_a2_residual_05.hint: Prediction Ω·x(1−x) minus the observation at x = 0.5; mind the sign.

f6_a2_objective.hint: Square all five residuals in J/mol and add them; predictions scale linearly with Ω.

f6_a2_j_22000.hint: Compare with the worked Ω = 18000 table: the residuals have the same size and opposite sign.

f6_a2_bounds_enough.hint: How many values of Ω lie inside the bounds?

f6_a4_omega.hint: Divide Σa·h by Σa²; a is dimensionless, so Ω* is in J/mol.

f6_a4_bound_active.hint: Is Ω* at 0 or 24000 J/mol, or between them?

f6_b2_pred_04.hint: Ω·x(1−x) at x = 0.4 with the fitted Ω; no refitting.

f6_b2_retune_ok.hint: Once a point has guided the choice of Ω, did it take part in the fit?

f6_b4_omega.hint: One equation: h_mix = Ω·x(1−x) at x = 0.25.

f6_b4_pred_04.hint: Use the Ω from x = 0.25 in Ω·x(1−x) at x = 0.4.

f6_b1_hmix.hint: The same-phase pure reference at x = 0.5 is (1 − x)·1000 + x·13000.

f6_b1_error.hint: Homogeneous h_mix minus the equilibrium-mixture value, both in J/mol.

f6_b3_identifiable.hint: Do different Ω give different predictions at x = 0 and x = 1?

f6_b3_B_identifiable.hint: Work out h = g − T·∂g/∂T for (A + B·T)·x(1−x): which terms are left?
